reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Source-provenance assessment and burden/enrichment reanalysis with technical/ancestry and testable-universe checks.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult prior burden/enrichment Methods or versioned documentation to select detailed analysis conditions and verify transfer before execution. Citation/provenance lookup is separate.

Does not define a complete primary burden/enrichment estimand and model with uncertainty and a declared multiplicity family. Generic calibrated p-values, prespecification or parameter lists do not provide those inferential choices.
Explains aggregate variant burden, differential ascertainment and the eligible/testable-gene enrichment null rather than equating a small p-value with pathway causation.

checks.quote: A reanalysis in which the signal disappears
checks.reason: Disappearance or loss of significance is treated as support/confirmation of artifact without comparing effect estimates and precision; reduced sample size, power or changed measurement can also cause it.
Specifies independent single-protocol replication using shared-callability/kinship and ancestry-checked burdens and an eligible-gene null; keeps association separate from mechanism.

checks.quote: permutation of phenotype within center and ancestry strata
checks.reason: Does not check that these strata contain both statuses or state how to handle complete center-status confounding; a permutation with no exchangeable labels is uninformative.
Failure to demonstrate equivalence is not proof of non-equivalence; the answer acknowledges that center-specific filters might produce a common intersection.
